records.name: Perscopia
records.evidence: Exact uppercase PERSCOPIA appears as a named customizable command in historical TeamSystem/GAMMA Evolution software documentation. It is not evidence of a current standalone company, but software-adjacent exact token use reduces the value of pursuing this variant when cleaner branches remain.

records.name: Recenvia
records.evidence: Exact-name web searches did not surface a substantiated current company, organization, app, software product or trademark identity in returned results. Returned strings were mainly OCR/spacing artifacts around other words. This is lightweight public-index evidence, not legal clearance.
records.remaining: linguistic/recoverability review + later lightweight public-TM/freshness before Owner exposure

records.name: Recenara
records.evidence: Recenara is an existing Portuguese verb form of recenar; Portuguese dictionaries define it as a conjugated form. This is not a company collision or legal bar, but it creates an unintended lexical reading and reduces the benefit of the coined surface.

diagnosis: Transformation Rescue improved namespace yield from 0/11 direct .com in the original advance set to 3/12 direct .com among bounded variants, but two of the three had non-domain issues. This supports rescue as useful but not magical; prototype/operator quality and linguistic reality still matter.
next_action: keep Recenvia internal; open one more bounded rescue across different strong seeds to test whether the method generalizes before expanding production
